title: feat: route DeepSeek V4.1 Flash to Azure
author: tomdacatto

gist.summary: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash switches its primary route from DeepInfra to Azure Sweden, with Fireworks retained as the fallback. Remote image URLs are converted to base64 for Azure, which does not accept the URLs directly. The model becomes available to Quest Pollen users as well as paid users; input and cached-token prices decrease, output-token pricing stays the same, and image tokens gain an explicit price. The Azure Preview route has a stated provider retirement date of 2026-12-15.
